corrections.text: The article states that the MacRumors report of September 18 'places the release just over a week after Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, where the iPhone Duo was introduced as Apple's first foldable smartphone.' The September 18 report itself does not mention the event; that context comes from MacRumors' separate September 9 coverage of the iPhone Duo announcement, and the interval is The Machine Herald's own calculation.
The article says the Xcode 27.1 beta simulator covers the device's 'configurations and display orientations.' MacRumors says the simulator 'supports the device's new poses and orientations.'
